releases.body:
## What's Changed
* e2e/tui.sh: wait for the Pinned heading in the toast's capture by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/416
* Add a captioned GIF of two issues fixed in parallel by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/417
* Pin the plugin API to OpenCode 2.2.4, keep OpenCode's schedule tools from spawned sessions, and trim CLAUDE.md by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/418
* Release 0.13.6 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/419


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.13.5...v0.13.6

## What's Changed
* Pin the plugin API to OpenCode 2.2.3 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/414
* Give latest.yml's live job 40 minutes and report a timeout apart from a failure by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/413
* Release 0.13.5 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/415


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.13.4...v0.13.5

## What's Changed
* Add CONTRIBUTING.md by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/408
* Wake Digby and spin the panel's own row while its session runs by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/409
* Release 0.13.4 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/410


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.13.3...v0.13.4

## What's Changed
* Digby runs still and awake, with a short dig every ten seconds or so by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/406
* Release 0.13.3 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/407


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.13.2...v0.13.3

## What's Changed
* Show the tree panel's own session as its first row by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/396
* Pin the plugin API to OpenCode 2.2.2 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/402
* Pin the feedback courier_answer reports on a rejection with a reason by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/403
* Read a session's time.busy before its transcript (OpenCode 2.2.2) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/404
* Release 0.13.2 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/405


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.13.1...v0.13.2

issues.title: Evaluate the tree records on a real model: does an orchestrator read them, and does its split change?
Memory for orchestration: a record per tree, a lesson per tree, and a view in the terminal
Relay a child's question (ask tool) to its parent, and the answer back
A renamed or unarchived idle child reads as running: other updates bump time.updated too
Memory: the recorded split line keeps its markdown, is clipped mid-word, and never shows a revised plan
Digby: a pixel from a finished report lingers into the idle animation
